summary.en: The limited-time Lifetime Pro promotion has ended. The price will return to its regular US$12.99. Thank you so much for your support and encouragement! As an independent developer, I truly appreciate everyone who has tried and supported Hide Photos: Secret Album. App Store pricing may take some time to update across regions. Please refer to the price shown on Apple's purchase confirmation screen.
summary.zh-CN: 终身 Pro 的短期优惠活动已经结束，价格将恢复至正常售价 US$12.99。非常感谢大家一直以来的支持与鼓励！作为一名独立开发者，每一位用户的信任和支持对我都非常重要。我会继续用心改进 Hide Photos: Secret Album。App Store 各地区价格更新可能存在延迟，请以 Apple 购买确认页面显示的实际价格为准。

title.en: Clarification on the Lifetime Pro promotion and pricing
title.zh-CN: 关于终身 Pro 免费活动及价格调整的说明

summary.en: Thank you to everyone who supported the free Lifetime Pro giveaway. The promotion has ended, but App Store screenshots cannot be updated immediately, and some people may still see the old offer. I am truly sorry for the confusion. During the version 1.8 review period, I have decided to temporarily set the Lifetime Pro price to US$2.99. After that, the regular price will return to US$12.99. I am an independent developer, still learning how to manage and promote an app. I did not handle this carefully enough, and I sincerely apologize for the misunderstanding. Thank you for your patience and support. I will keep improving Hide Photos: Secret Album. Please note: The updated App Store price may take up to 24 hours to appear across all regions and devices. Until the change is fully reflected, some users may still see the previous US$12.99 price. Please refer to the price shown on Apple's purchase confirmation screen.
summary.zh-CN: 之前举办的终身 Pro 免费赠送活动已经结束，非常感谢大家的支持！由于 App Store 的宣传截图无法立即更新，部分用户仍然看到了免费活动的信息，因此产生了误会。对此，我真的非常抱歉。为了弥补这次沟通上的不足，我决定在 1.8 版本审核期间，暂时将终身 Pro 价格调整为 US$2.99；之后会恢复正式价格 US$12.99。我只是一名普通的独立开发者，在应用运营方面还有很多需要学习和改进的地方。这次是我考虑不够周全，给大家带来了困扰。真的很抱歉，也感谢大家的理解和支持。我会继续认真改进 Hide Photos: Secret Album。 请注意：App Store 的新价格可能需要最多 24 小时才能在所有地区和设备上显示。在价格同步完成前，部分用户可能仍会看到原价 US$12.99，请以 Apple 购买确认页面实际显示的价格为准。
